test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The award was presented to her by the director.

options.text: She presented the award to the director.
The award presented to her by the director.
The director presented the award to her.
She was presenting the award to the director.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The director presented the award to her.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **subject** of the **Active Voice** is changed into the **object** of the **Passive Voice**. Also, the **object** of the **Active Voice** is changed into the **subject** of the **Passive Voice**.
 
• The usage of a **helping verb** is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.
 
• The preposition **“by”** is used before the object made in Passive Voice. However, it is optional in some cases.
 
• The **sentence** provided in the question is in Passive Voice.
 
• To change the sentence to Active Voice, use the format: **Subject + Verb + Object.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **The director presented the award to her.**
